set.body:
Plan: docs/institutional-readiness-plan.md
Work key: F05
Accountable role (person not assigned): Frontend/integration engineer

Outcome: A signed-in user finds permitted projects/datasets and manages collaboration without typing internal IDs.

Acceptance:
- Implement bounded authorized directory/search APIs and console navigation from login through lab/project/dataset to existing release and curation screens.
- Provide human-readable collaborator selection, effective-access explanation, scope/future-release distinction, expiry and revocation under the same backend contracts.
- Include empty/denied/error/stale-session states, keyboard/focus behavior and leakage checks for titles, counts and suggestions; do not duplicate authority rules in the browser.

Evidence anchors:
- modules/http/src/main/scala/sanctity/http/RepositoryHttp.scala
- modules/http/src/main/resources/sanctity/ui/app.js

Status: planned; no implementation or qualification claimed.
set.title: F05: Deliver authorized lab and project discovery in the console
